preconditions.description: The length of string S is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The length of string T is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: S.isalpha() and all(c in 'ABC' for c in S)
preconditions.description: String S consists only of uppercase English letters 'A', 'B', and 'C'.

preconditions.expression: T.isalpha() and all(c in 'ABC' for c in T)
preconditions.description: String T consists only of uppercase English letters 'A', 'B', and 'C'.
The number of queries Q is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= bi <= len(S) for ai, bi, ci, di in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, ai and bi are valid indices of string S.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ci <= di <= len(T) for ai, bi, ci, di in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, ci and di are valid indices of string T.

postconditions.description: The output string has exactly Q characters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string is either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == '1' if is_transformable(S[ai-1:bi], T[ci-1:di]) else stdout[i] == '0' for i, (ai, bi, ci, di) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: The i-th character in the output string is '1' if T[ci..di] can be created from S[ai..bi] using the given transitions, otherwise '0'.
